title: Mana Hub universal
features:
Visual Tab
ESP Highlights — Player highlights with configurable fill/outline

ESP Fill — Toggle fill on highlights

ESP Names — Show player names overhead

ESP Distance — Show distance to players

ESP Health Bars — Overhead health indicators

ESP Chams — Character chams through walls

Crosshair — Custom on-screen crosshair

Tracers — Lines from screen bottom to each player

Box ESP — 2D bounding boxes around players

Skeleton ESP — Skeleton wireframe overlay

Fullbright — Removes darkness/lighting effects

No Fog — Disables fog

AimAssist Tab
Aim Assist Toggle — Enable/disable aim assist

FOV Mode — Camera (FOV circle centered on screen) or Mouse (FOV circle follows cursor)

Aim Keybind — Rebindable to any key or RMB (default: Right Click)

Hold to Aim — Aim only tracks while keybind is held

FOV Radius — Adjustable FOV circle size (10–500)

Smoothness — Aim lerp speed (1–20)

Target Part — Head, HumanoidRootPart, or UpperTorso

Show FOV Circle — Visual FOV circle display

Sticky Aim — Faster lock when re-targeting same player

Aim Prediction — Leads targets based on velocity

Team Check — Skip teammates (off by default)

Aim Shake — Adds humanized jitter (0–10)

Silent Aim — Silent aim module

Triggerbot — Auto-fire with configurable delay (0–500ms)

Movement Tab
WalkSpeed — Toggle + slider (1–300)

JumpPower — Toggle + slider (1–300)

Noclip — Walk through walls (admin only)

Fly — Free flight with adjustable speed (1–300)

Infinite Jump — Jump mid-air

Anti AFK — Prevents idle kick

Auto Sprint

Interface Tab
6 Themes — Midnight, Cyberpunk, Ocean, Emerald, Sunset, Frost

Rainbow Accent — Cycling accent color with adjustable speed

Compact Mode — Smaller toggle rows

Array List — Active modules sidebar display

Array Shimmer — Animated gradient on array list entries

Config Tab
Profile System — Create, save, load, delete profiles

Exit Hub — Clean shutdown

Global
Keybinds — RightCtrl (minimize), RightShift (hide), Escape (drag mode), Semicolon (command bar)

Command Bar — Text commands for quick actions

FPS & Ping Display — Live stats in title bar

Draggable UI — Drag mode toggle for repositioning
